title: Hungary's Diplomatic Strategy in a Multipolar World
grammar: Diplomatic conditionals in strategy and balance (méltányos volna elismerni, előnyösnek tekintené)
goal: I can analyze the doctrine of economic connectivity vs. decoupling in Hungary's foreign policy.
I can use diplomatic conditionals to balance competing national interests and evaluate strategic outcomes.
I can discuss battery investments, Eastern Opening (Keleti Nyitás), and the role of medium-sized states in global trade.
